title: Design System Source Descriptor
description: The explicit, package-owned API descriptor at packages/<id>/design-system.source.json (schemaVersion 4, contractVersion 4). It declares the 29 required components and only the optional components the system actually implements. Omitting an optional component means it is unavailable; there are no boolean false entries and no second capability list. Component entries may carry an optional `effects` declaration; missing effects means undeclared and is never inferred. The optional `entrypoints` map declares additional public code entrypoints (their contained source module and explicit required package names, never dependency ranges), and the optional nonempty `extensions` map declares PascalCase custom named exports with docs/example references, an apiVersion, and an optional effects declaration. A neutral system omits both sections. Visual values are not stored here: semantic tokens live in the separate packages/<id>/tokens.source.json. It is a repository-only input and is not shipped in the tarball. scripts/design-system-manifest.mjs validates it and emits the shipped design-system.json manifest (schemaVersion 5).

contractVersion.description: The numeric component contract version the package implements. Only version 4 is supported.

name.description: Human-facing display name; cross-checked against prismSystem.name.

components.description: The 29 required components plus only implemented optional components. Absence means the optional component is unavailable.

entrypoints.description: Optional declaration of additional public code entrypoints, keyed "." or a concrete lower-kebab "./subpath". Only code entries may be declared: CSS, manifest, and package.json asset exports are never entrypoints. Every declared key must exist in package.json exports, and every additional code export in package.json must be declared here. A neutral system omits this section.

extensions.description: Optional nonempty map of custom named exports (never canonical component names) keyed by the PascalCase runtime named export. Requirements are not repeated here; they belong to the referenced entrypoint. A neutral system omits this section.

effects.description: Explicit visual-effects declaration. Missing means undeclared. `fallback` is only meaningful for webgl/mixed rendering, and a `3d` feature requires webgl or mixed rendering (CSS depth is not WebGL).

features.description: Nonempty unique subset of the closed effect-feature set.

rendering.description: DOM/CSS rendering, real WebGL rendering, or a mixed DOM+WebGL component.

reducedMotion.description: Whether the component implements a tested reduced-motion behavior.

fallback.description: Graphics fallback behavior; only valid for webgl/mixed rendering.

entrypoint.description: One declared public code entrypoint. `source` is a contained TypeScript module statically inspected for its runtime exports; `requires` lists explicit package names whose ranges are resolved from package.json (dependency/peer), never duplicated here.

source.description: Package-relative contained source entry module (.ts or .tsx).

requires.description: Explicit package names this entrypoint requires, resolved against package.json dependencies/optionalDependencies/peerDependencies. An empty list means no additional declared prerequisites.

extension.description: One custom extension: a PascalCase runtime named export of a declared code entrypoint, with real packaged docs/example references and an apiVersion. Extensions never reuse canonical component names and never repeat dependency requirements.

apiVersion.description: Positive extension API version owned by this design system.

entrypoint.description: A declared code entrypoint key (never "./tokens") that exports the extension at runtime.

docs.description: Package-relative documentation file containing runnable snippets.

example.description: Package-relative example file with a real usage scenario.
